name: Forest floor
text: Plain ground with no intensity. Creatures nearby change it; on its own it only grows things that need nothing.

name: Shimmering ground
text: Shimmer grows crystals up out of the ground: a few glinting chips at first, tall crystal spires at its strongest.

name: Fae-touched ground
text: Spirit draws a quiet fae mist over the ground, with old roots and hollows where it gathers. Things found there are veiled until you look closely.

name: Mossy ground
text: Spore softens the grass with moss and mist, from dewy spores to little puddles. It slowly drifts outward and settles in low ground.

name: Glowing ground
text: Glow scatters motes and glowing moss. Faint by day, bright at night, and bright in fae-touched ground even by day.

name: Flowering ground
text: Bloom fills the grass with flowers that open in the morning, peak at midday and close at dusk.

name: Lush grass
text: Verdure thickens the grass into tall growth where small things can hide.

name: Shallow pool
text: Where Spore settles into fae-touched hollows it pools into shallow water, joined into ponds with neighbouring pools.

name: Mossy bank
text: Shimmer, Spore and Verdure together grow moss over ground and crystal, and bugs gather there.

name: Wild meadow
text: Bloom and Verdure together make a tangle of flowers in long grass, where plants grow fast.

name: Foxfire Fen
text: Spore and Glow together: roots through misty moss glow with foxfire, slowly brightening and fading as if the ground were breathing.

name: Rain Garden
text: Spore and Bloom together: dewy flowers between little puddles, at their best in the rain.

name: Dewcrystal Dell
text: Spore and Shimmer together: dewy crystals in a mossy dell, where shelf mushrooms cling.

name: Fernbrake
text: Spore and Verdure together: a misty thicket of ferns that draws finds in.

name: Crystal Glade
text: Glow and Shimmer together: crystals push up through the grass and catch the light.

name: Lantern Hollow
text: Glow and Spirit together: a misty hollow with glowing specks, brightest at night.

name: Moonlit Garden
text: Glow and Bloom together: pale flowers that open their light after dark.

name: Wisp Thicket
text: Glow and Verdure together: long grass where little wisps of light drift at night.

name: Prism Garden
text: Bloom and Shimmer together: flowers growing between little crystals, open in the sun.

name: Sunken Garden
text: Bloom and Spirit together: flowers growing down in a quiet, misty hollow.

name: Dreaming Hollow
text: Shimmer and Spirit together: a dreaming hollow of crystals under a veil of mist, full of geodes.

name: Overgrown Crystals
text: Shimmer and Verdure together: ivy and moss creeping over old crystals.

name: Root Tangle
text: Spirit and Verdure together: old roots knotted through the misty ground.

name: Glowworm Grotto
text: Spore, Glow and Spirit at their strongest: a dripping grotto lit by glowworms. Legendary ground.

name: Heartwood Grove
text: Bloom, Verdure and Spirit at their strongest: an old grove around deep roots. Legendary ground.

name: Heartstone Vein
text: Glow, Shimmer and Spirit at their strongest: a glowing vein of heart-crystal under the fae mist. Legendary ground.

name: Amethyst Seep
text: Spore, Glow and Shimmer at their strongest: violet crystals in misty, seeping water. Legendary ground.

name: Treeline
text: The dense forest around your clearing. Nothing grows there for you yet; the clearing pushes it back as your land develops.
